####STEP_1

###1-load the data
```{r}
##load data
RA1=Read10X("../../tomas.gomes/processed.data/autoimm_scrna_TomasGuerreiro/Datasets/Rheumatoid Arthritis/RA28")
RA2=Read10X("../../tomas.gomes/processed.data/autoimm_scrna_TomasGuerreiro/Datasets/Rheumatoid Arthritis/RA50")
```


###2-Create seurat obj
```{r}
#sobj for each sample, label and QC metric for each objects
obj1=CreateSeuratObject(RA1, project = "RA1")
obj2=CreateSeuratObject(RA2,project = "RA2")
obj1$sample="RA1"
obj2$sample="RA2"
saveRDS(obj1,file = "data/process/SeuratObjects/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RA1.rds")
saveRDS(obj2,file = "data/process/SeuratObjects/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RA2.rds")

```


###STEP_2:PROCESS,ANALYSE...

###1-the qc 
```{r}
##load the file
obj1=readRDS("data/process/SeuratObjects/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RA1.rds")
obj2=readRDS("data/process/SeuratObjects/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RA2.rds")
##QC
obj1[["percent.mt"]]=PercentageFeatureSet(obj1, pattern = "^MT-")
obj2[["percent.mt"]]=PercentageFeatureSet(obj2, pattern = "^MT-")
VlnPlot(obj1, features = c("nFeature_RNA","nCount_RNA","percent.mt"),ncol = 3, log = TRUE)
obj1=subset(obj1,subset=nFeature_RNA>600 & nFeature_RNA<8000 & percent.mt<30)
VlnPlot(obj2, features = c("nFeature_RNA","nCount_RNA","percent.mt"),ncol = 3, log = TRUE)
obj2=subset(obj2,subset=nFeature_RNA>100 & nFeature_RNA<8000 & percent.mt<20)
##merge
RA_obj = merge(obj1, y = obj2, add.cell.ids = c("RA1", "RA2"))
saveRDS(RA_obj, file = "data/process/SeuratObjects/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RA_raw.rds")
RA_obj=readRDS("data/process/SeuratObjects/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RA_raw.rds")
#save memorie
rm(obj1,obj2,RA1,RA2)
gc(full = TRUE)

#look for the assay if not RNA set it as RNA
DefaultAssay(RA_obj) 
#if not 
DefaultAssay(RA_obj) <- "RNA"
```



###2-Statistics
```{r}
##norm, fvf,scale,runpca
RA_obj=NormalizeData(RA_obj)
RA_obj=FindVariableFeatures(RA_obj)
RA_obj=ScaleData(RA_obj,vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA","percent.mt"),features = VariableFeatures(object = RA_obj))
RA_obj=RunPCA(RA_obj, features = VariableFeatures(object = RA_obj))
ElbowPlot(RA_obj, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")


```


###3-integration
```{r}

##integration
library(harmony)
RA_obj =RunHarmony(RA_obj,group.by.vars = "sample",orig.reduction = "pca",dims.use = 1:30  )
RA_obj[["RNA"]]=JoinLayers(RA_obj[["RNA"]])
RA_obj = RunUMAP(RA_obj, reduction = "harmony", dims= 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")
p=DimPlot(RA_obj,reduction = "umap.harmony",group.by = c("sample"),label.size = 2, shuffle = T)
ggsave(filename = "output/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RA.integration.png", plot=p, width = 12, height = 8)


#for the resolution
RA_obj=FindNeighbors(RA_obj,reduction = "harmony",dims = 1:30)
for (res in seq(0.2, 1, by = 0.1)) {
  RA_obj=FindClusters(RA_obj, resolution = res)
  colname = paste0("res_", gsub("\\.", "_", res))
RA_obj[[colname]] = RA_obj$seurat_clusters

}
res_cols <- grep("^res_", colnames(RA_obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)
for (res in res_cols) {
  p=DimPlot(RA_obj, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap.harmony") +
       ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
  print(p)
  readline(prompt="Press [Enter] to see the next resolution...")
}

#save 
p=DimPlot(RA_obj, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "res_0_3", label = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +ggtitle("Resolution_0.3")
ggsave(filename = "output/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RAresolution.png",plot = p,width = 12,height = 8,dpi = 300)

```





###4-Clusters and find markers
```{r}
###cluster----------

###clusters
RA_obj=FindNeighbors(RA_obj,reduction= "harmony",dims = 1:30)
RA_obj=FindClusters(RA_obj, resolution = 0.3,cluster.name = "harmony_clusters")

#marker
RA_markers=FindAllMarkers(RA_obj,only.pos = TRUE,min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
RA_markers=RA_markers %>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)
write.xlsx(RA_markers,file = "output/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RA_markers.xlsx")


##the average and correlation 
av.expRA=AverageExpression(RA_obj)$RNA
correlation_matrixRA=cor(as.matrix(av.expRA), 
                          as.matrix(av.expRA))
library(pheatmap)
pheatmap(
  correlation_matrixRA,
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  main = "Correlation between Cluster Groups in Rheumatoid Arthritis",
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  filename = "output/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RA_corr.png",
  width = 8,
  height = 8
)



```

RA_obj$celltype=Idents(RA_obj)
##2color
celltype_cols=c(
  "Fibroblasts"                  = "#D73027",  
  "B cells"                      = "#4575B4", 
  "Neutrophils"                  = "#FDAE61",  
  "NK/T cells"                   = "#1B9E77", 
  "Endothelial cells"            = "#66A61E", 
  "Mast cells"                   = "#A6761D", 
  "Plasmacytoid DCs"             = "#984EA3",  
  "Plasmablasts"                 = "#E69F00",
  "Dendritic cells"              = "#E7298A",
  "Pericytes/Mural cells"        = "#000000",
   "Macrophages"                 = "#762A83"
  )

##3 center
##3 center
umap_df=as.data.frame(Embeddings(RA_obj, "umap.harmony"))
colnames(umap_df)=c("umap_1", "umap_2")
umap_df$celltype=RA_obj$celltype
centers=aggregate(
  cbind(umap_1, umap_2) ~ celltype,
  data = umap_df,
  FUN = median
)


##supp duplicate and plot
library(ggrepel)
suppressWarnings({
  fig1a=ggplot(umap_df, aes(umap_1, umap_2, color = celltype)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = celltype_cols) +
    geom_label_repel(
      data = centers,
      aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, label = celltype),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "white",
      color = "black",
      size = 3,
      box.padding = 0.4,
      label.size = 0.25,
      segment.color = NA,
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    labs(x = "umap 1", y = "umap 2")
})
fig1a
ggsave(ggsave(filename = "output/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RAcellT.png", plot = fig1a, width = 12, height = 8))

```{r}
##-proportion of cells
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Use explicit dplyr:: functions to avoid masking issues
prop_df <- dplyr::as_tibble(RA_obj@meta.data) %>%
  dplyr::count(`sample`, celltype) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(`sample`) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(proportion = n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

##rename col
RA_obj_meta <- dplyr::as_tibble(RA_obj@meta.data) %>%
  dplyr::rename(sample_id = sample)   # rename to avoid conflicts
prop_df=RA_obj_meta %>%
  dplyr::count(sample_id, celltype) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_id) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(proportion = n / sum(n)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
##plot
fig1c=ggplot(
  prop_df,
  aes(x = celltype, y = proportion, color = celltype)
) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = celltype_cols) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  ylab("Proportion") +
  xlab("")
fig1c
ggsave(filename = "output/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RA_cell_proportion.png", plot = fig1c, width = 12, height = 10)
```



##6proportion of donors
```{r}
##proportion of Donors

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

#change colname 
RA_obj$Donors = RA_obj$sample

#create the meta data
meta = RA_obj@meta.data[, c("harmony_clusters", "Donors")]
table(meta$Donors)

# Make sure dplyr functions are used explicitly
meta = RA_obj@meta.data

#the  percentage 
donors_counts = meta %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(harmony_clusters,Donors) %>% #count cells each donor use in each cluster
  dplyr::summarise( n= dplyr::n(),.groups = "drop") %>% #numb of cells
  dplyr::group_by(harmony_clusters) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(proportion = n /sum(n))  #fraction of cells per donor
```




```{r}
###plot
p = ggplot(donors_counts, aes(
  x = harmony_clusters,
  y = proportion,
  group = Donors,
  color = Donors
)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo", name = "Donor") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "Donors Proportion",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Proportion (%)"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
p

ggsave(filename = "output/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RADonor.png", plot = p, width = 12, height = 8)
```



```{r}
##correlation with the celltype
# 1️⃣ Set identities to cell types
Idents(RA_obj) <- "celltype"

# sanity check
levels(Idents(RA_obj))
# should show cell type names

# 2️⃣ Average expression per cell type
av.expIPF <- AverageExpression(
  RA_obj,
  assays = "RNA",
  slot = "data"
)$RNA

# 3️⃣ Cell-type correlation matrix
correlation_matrixIPF <- cor(
  as.matrix(av.expIPF),
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

# safety cleanup
correlation_matrixIPF[is.na(correlation_matrixIPF)] <- 0

# 4️⃣ Save heatmap as PNG
png(
  filename = "output/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RAcelltypecorr.png",
  width = 3000,
  height = 2400,
  res = 300
)
library(pheatmap)
colors=colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100)
pheatmap(
  correlation_matrixIPF,
  color = colors,
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  fontsize_row = 9,
  fontsize_col = 9
)

dev.off()
```









##TO save the final meta.data
```{r}
##save
# Keep your existing metadata names
RA_obj$orig.ident="Rheumatoid Arthritis"

# Remove unwanted columns 
cols_to_remove=c(
  grep("res_|RNA_snn_res", colnames(RA_obj@meta.data), value = TRUE),
  "cell_type",
  "iscell_ed",
  "iscell_dd",
  "Donors",
  "seurat_clusters"
)
RA_obj@meta.data=RA_obj@meta.data[, !(colnames(RA_obj@meta.data) %in% cols_to_remove)]

# Ensure active identity reflects your celltype
Idents(RA_obj)=RA_obj$celltype

# Save 
saveRDS(RA_obj, file = "data/process/SeuratObjects/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RA_Final.rds")

# Save only the final metadata 
saveRDS(RA_obj@meta.data, file = "data/process/SeuratObjects/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RA_obj.metadata.rds")

# Optional CSV 
write.csv(RA_obj@meta.data, 
          file = "data/process/SeuratObjects/Rheumatoid_Arthritis/RA_obj.metadata.csv",
          row.names = TRUE)
View(RA_obj@meta.data)

```
